title: Bala Hisar Fort
tagline: The hill that held the city
explainer: This hill fort has watched Peshawar for centuries. Whoever held it held the city below. Today it is still a military site, which is why the walls look closed-off even as the bazaar runs right up to them.

title: Qissa Khwani Bazaar
explainer: The 'street of storytellers' was where caravans stopped and news travelled by tea and talk. In 1930 a protest here was fired on; the bazaar is still the city's living room, not a museum.

title: Islamia College
explainer: Opened in 1913 so boys from the frontier could study without leaving home. The red-brick campus is a landmark of that bet: education in Peshawar, not only in the cities further east.
